Method of Attack: Encrypts virtual hard drives by mounting VHD and VHDX files using Windows Virtual Storage API (OpenVirtualDisk, AttachVirtualDisk, GetVirtualDiskPhysicalPath)
Closes open files for encryption using Windows Restart Manager API
Excludes termination of processes containing 'vnc', 'ssh', 'mstsc', 'System', or 'svchost.exe' to avoid disrupting critical or attacker access processes
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Hyper-V virtual machines and virtual hard disks (VHD, VHDX)
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection targeting Windows systems, encrypting files and virtual hard disks
Indicators of Compromise: .mouse file extension appended to encrypted files
